page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.ebmgn7i.32xlarge is an x86_64 architecture bare-metal server instance utilizing the KVM hypervisor. It features 128 dedicated physical CPU cores with a 1:1 thread-to-core ratio, ensuring no hyperthreading overhead. The system is equipped with 768.0 GB of system memory, providing 6.0 GB of RAM per core.

This instance integrates four NVIDIA A10 GPUs, delivering a combined total of 96 GB of VRAM. It does not include local NVMe or SSD storage, meaning all storage requirements must be met through network-attached block storage. Network connectivity is supported by a baseline bandwidth of 64 Gbps.

Given the dedicated physical core allocation and high-density GPU acceleration, this instance is designed for compute-intensive and parallel processing workloads. The hardware profile is optimized for deep learning inference, graphics rendering, and high-performance computing tasks. The lack of local storage requires external storage provisioning, which should be factored into the overall deployment architecture.
